tools.name: get_info
tools.description:
What Santa's Calling is: a live, personalised phone call from Santa for a child in the UK (£6.99, about 3 minutes,
ages 2-16). Includes price, how a gift works, safety and links.

tools.description: Parents' frequently asked questions: what happens on the call, cost, safety, which phones, missed calls, refunds.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "buy_gift_call" is 990 chars, far longer than this server's median (161). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
